title: senna macranthera var. quadrifoliolata
intro: Senna macranthera var. quadrifoliolata, commonly known as Mexican senna, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to Mexico and parts of Central America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of constipation and other gastrointestinal issues, as it acts as a natural laxative. The therapeutic actions of Mexican senna include stimulating the bowels to produce a bowel movement, relaxing the muscles in the intestines, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, such as anthraquinone derivatives, which are responsible for its laxative properties and other medicinal effects.
